title: CollectionRequest
description: What the hub's ProviderGateway adapter sends to POST /providers/{provider}/collections. Not in the frozen OpenAPI (the provider-side API is the double's), so this file is the contract of record for slice 04's adapter and slice 14's reader.

reference.description: The caller's idempotency key; the top-up uuid, so a retry names the same charge.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units. Never a float.

payer_msisdn.description: E.164; the synthetic range the seeded data uses.
